description: Four delivery workflow DAGs for professional services. Seeded into kimmp_workflows table.

workflows.name: Project Kick-off
workflows.description: Briefs WAANDA on new project, sets goals, generates milestone plan, assigns initial risks, notifies client.

workflows.name: Milestone Review
workflows.description: 7-day pre-milestone health check. Routes to internal flag or client update based on status.

workflows.name: Risk Escalation
workflows.description: CRITICAL risk triggers: assessment → decision proposal → L3 approval → client notification.

workflows.name: Project Closure
workflows.description: Quality check → WAANDA brief → client sign-off → COIG checkpoint → lessons learned.
